subject: Request: expired trial — ask for temporary credits / lifeline
messages:
From: Alex Chu <alex@acme.ai>
To: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial expired — possible short credit to finish eval?

Hi Priya,

We kicked off a small evaluation of Redwood in May and got good early results, but our procurement and security reviews stalled the account and the trial credits expired last week. We're close to validating the integration (running multitenant routing tests + KV cache scenarios) but don't have enough headroom to finish the last 2 end-to-end tests.

Would Redwood be able to provision a short, one-time credit so we can complete the evaluation? If helpful I attached our usage export and the short list of tests we still need to run.

We're trying to avoid restarting the whole procurement cycle; an extension or a small promo credit will let us finish and surface any remaining ops questions. If there are limits on what you can do in a self-serve account, please point me to the right person.

Thanks,
Alex Chu
Director, ML Infrastructure
Acme.ai

Attachments: trial-usage-report.csv (CSV, 14KB)

From: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Chu <alex@acme.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial expired — possible short credit to finish eval?

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and the usage export. Glad to hear the integration is shaping up.

Short answer: yes, we can often provide a one-time "credit lifeline" for situations like this, but it needs manager sign-off and a brief finance note since it touches billing entitlements. If you can confirm the two tests that need to run and an estimated token spend, I can escalate today and get a provisional amount reserved while we process approvals.

Proposed next step from my side: I can provision a conditional 20k-token credit (valid 30 days) pending final approval; if that works for you I'll start the approval thread internally. If you have a preference for dollar-valued credit rather than tokens, let me know.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0124

From: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Credit lifeline request — Acme.ai (need approval)

Ben / Laura — forwarding a request from Acme.ai. They lost trial headroom while procurement was handling security questionnaires; they're asking for a short credit so they can finish two remaining end-to-end tests. Summary:
- Account: Acme.ai (ACME-2026-PLG-91)
- Ask: one-time credit to finish validation; proposed 20k tokens / 30 days
- Rationale: avoids re-run of procurement and keeps momentum for a Dedicated/DPA conversation

I've attached the usage export from the customer and a draft memo for finance. My recommendation: approve a conditional 20k-token credit (approx $450 at list) and set a 45-day validity to give them a little extra runway. If you prefer dollar-credits we can set $500. Also proposing a short clause — credit only applies to non-production evaluation and will not be refunded for billing activity.

Attaching approval-memo.pdf for signatures. Please reply with thumbs-up / changes and I'll finalize.

Thanks,
Priya

Attachments: approval-memo.pdf (PDF, 22KB)

From: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Chu <alex@acme.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: temporary credit provisioned for Acme.ai — next steps

Hi Alex — good news. Pricing and finance have approved a one-time evaluation grant for Acme.ai. Details below and next steps.

What we granted
- One-time credit: 20,000 tokens ("credit lifeline") — active now
- Validity window: 45 days from provisioning (expires 2026-08-02)
- Usage scope: evaluation/sandbox only; not applicable to production accounts

What we did for you
- I provisioned the credit against ACME-2026-PLG-91 in our console; you should see a banner in the sandbox project in the next 30 minutes. Link: https://app.redwoodinference.com/console/projects/acme-sandbox
- We also pre-populated a small amendment to the trial terms (non-legal, administrative) to capture the credit grant. If you need the legal team involved we can route a short DocuSign.

Action items for Acme.ai
1) Confirm the two tests you plan to run and an estimated token burn so we can track utilization.
2) If you want the credit expressed as a dollar amount, reply and we can convert it on the fly.
3) If procurement requires a signed acknowledgment, use this DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/REC/1234567890

Internal notes: Ben / Laura — thanks for the quick review and sign-off. We left a 45-day window to reduce back-and-forth.

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: credit-grant.pdf (PDF, 6KB)
